bankEmpty: This BNK has no embedded audio. It may reference external media.
audioError: Audio playback failed. Try exporting the original file.
audioFormatHint: BNK is a sound bank and WEM is Wwise-encoded media. Use Wwise-compatible tools for these files; choose MP3 for general-purpose players.
emptyHint: Open files or a folder containing DB assets.
name: Name
motionHint: Disable portrait entrance, background motion and model auto-rotation.
rawHint: Raw data is not a converted, universally usable format.
exportHint: Choose an output folder next. Existing files are never overwritten.
onlyDesktop: Open DB files in the desktop application. This browser view only displays the interface and artwork.
chooseSkin: Choose a skin to load assets
stopped: Operation cancelled. Reload assets to continue.
catalogHint: Open the matching DB to preview and export assets.
exportStopped: Export cancelled. Files already written are kept.
diagnosticsTruncated: Only the first diagnostic messages are shown. The totals include all reported errors and warnings.
parseCoverageHint: Full byte consumption does not prove semantic correctness. Partial and generic rows are not automatically errors.
animationVariants: Several related models/LODs use this clip. The most detailed linked instance is shown to avoid overlapping models.
animationNoTracks: This clip has no model-transform tracks supported by this viewer. Playback is not simulated.
animationTextures: Some linked textures are missing or could not be decoded; material preview is incomplete.
animationProperties: This clip includes custom property or object-swap tracks. Only supported model/skeleton tracks are played.
animationParticles: Related particles were found, but Unity particle simulation and custom shaders are not yet reproduced by this viewer.
animationNoModel: No verified related model was found; unrelated models are never substituted. Original animation export remains available.
animationCurveOnly: No confirmed model reference. Original keyframes are shown; lines visualize samples, not particle or material simulation.
bankSelectAudio: Select an audio item to load its preview
fontSample: Type text to preview the font
